responsibility: Implements the AVX-512 VBMI + AVX-512VL intrinsic header for 128-bit and 256-bit byte permutation and multishift functionality. It exposes masked and unmasked VL-sized forms of multishift and byte permute/permutex2var operations, extending the VBMI API below 512 bits and separating those narrower forms from the full-width definitions in avx512vbmiintrin.h.
